summary: ## **CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI** ## **Petition No. 89/MP/2026** ## **Coram:** **Shri Jishnu Barua, Chairperson Shri Ramesh Babu V., Member Shri Harish Dudani, Member** ## **Date of Order: 2[nd] March, 2026** ## **In the matter of** Petition under Sections 79(1)(c) and (f) of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Regulation 42 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Connectivity and General Network Access to the inter-State Transmission System) Regulations, 2022 seeking directions to Central Transmission Utility of India Limited to forthwith process the application made by the Petitioners for installation of additional generation capacity and Energy Storage System under Regulation 5.2 of the GNA Regulations. ## **And in the matter of** ## **1. ACME Solar Holdings Limited,** Plot No. 152, Sector 44, Gurgaon, Haryana – 122002 ## **2. ACME Surya Power Private Limited,** Plot No. 152, Sector 44, Gurgaon, Haryana – 122002 **Petitioners** ## **VERSUS** ## **1. Central Transmission Utility of India Limited,** Floors No. 5th-10th, IRCON International Tower, Tower 1, Plot No. 16, Institutional Area, Sector-32, Gurugram, Haryana-122003 ** Respondent** ## **Parties Present:** Shri Aniket Prasoon, Advocate, ASHL & ACME Surya Ms. Tanya Bajaj, Advocate, ASHL & ACME Surya ## **ORDER** The present Petition has been filed jointly by the Petitioners, ACME Solar Holdings Limited and ACME Surya Power Private Limited, seeking the following reliefs: ## _“_ _**(ix) Relief Sought**_ Order in Petition No. 89/MP/2026 Page 1 _57. In the light of the facts and circumstances mentioned above, it is respectfully prayed that this Hon’ble Commission may graciously be pleased to:_ _(a) Admit the present Petition;_ _(b) Direct Central Transmission Utility of India Limited to forthwith process the Application dated 14.08.2025 bearing Application No. 2200002332 submitted by the Petitioners for additional generation capacity of 190 MW of solar capacity and 250 MW of ESS under Regulation 5.2 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Connectivity and General Network Access to the inter-State Transmission System) Regulations, 2022 (as amended) within the quantum of 300 MW connectivity already granted to ACME Solar Holdings Limited at the Bikaner-II Pooling Station; and/or_ _(c) pass any other or further order(s) as this Hon’ble Commission may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the present case and interest of justice._ ## _**(x) Interim Relief Sought**_ _58. In the light of the facts and circumstances mentioned above, it is respectfully prayed that this Commission may graciously be pleased to:_ _(a) List the present application on the earliest convenient date to this Hon’ble Commission, not later than 09.12.2025;_ _(b) Restrain Central Transmission Utility of India Limited from allocating the non-solar hour access in AHSL’s connectivity of 300 MW at Bikaner-II to any third party till the disposal of the present Petition; and/or_ _(c) pass any other or further order(s) as this Commission may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the present case and interest of justice.”_ 2. The present Petition was filed on 27.11.2025. Pursuant to the filing of the Petition, the Petitioners, _vide_ affidavit dated 5.2.2026, have submitted that the Commission, vide order dated 12.12.2025, passed in Petition No. 452/MP/2025 titled _‘ACME Solar Holdings Limited and Anr. v. CTUIL’_ , allowed Petitioner No. 1 to retain and utilise its 300 MW Connectivity at Bikaner-II and further directed CTUIL to process the application made by the Petitioners for installation of additional generation capacity and an Energy Storage System under Regulation 5.2 of the GNA Regulations, 2022. The Petitioners have further submitted that the issues raised in the present Petition stood duly adjudicated as per the above order dated 12.12.2025 in Order in Petition No. 89/MP/2026 Page 2 Petition No. 452/MP/2025 and accordingly, have sought permission to withdraw the present Petition and to adjust the filing fees paid in the instant Petition against any other Petition to be filed on behalf of the Petitioners in future. 3. Considering the submissions of the Petitioners, the Petitioners are permitted to withdraw the present Petition. However, the prayer to adjust the filing fee paid in the present Petition is not allowed. 4. Accordingly, Petition No. 89/MP/2026 is disposed of, ‘as withdrawn’. sd/sd/sd/- **(Harish Dudani) (Ramesh Babu V.) (Jishnu Barua) Member Member Chairperson** Order in Petition No. 89/MP/2026 Page 3 CERC Website S. No. 138/2026
